story.kernfrage: How many independent rational linear relations exist among two-loop dihedral modular graph functions C(a,b,c) of weight w, E(w) and zeta(w) for w = 3, 5, 7, 9, 11, and which Laplace equations do they satisfy?
story.kernaussage: For weights 3, 5, 7 and 9 the space of rational linear relations among the dihedral modular graph functions C(a,b,c), E(w) and zeta(w) has dimension exactly one per weight (found numerically to 32 digits, with an explicit weight-9 relation and a verified weight-11 relation on a reduced basis), and these functions obey inhomogeneous Laplace equations with eigenvalues s(s-1) and sources built from Eisenstein series products and zeta values.
story.titel: Rational Linear Relations and Laplace Equations for Dihedral Modular Graph Functions up to Weight 11
